title: The job
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: A HELP WANTED sign on 101. Wood applies with a monologue. He gets it anyway.

panels.composition: Highway 101. A low building: HECETA FRAME & MATTING. A HELP WANTED card in the window. WOOD's Datsun pulling in.

image.prompt: a low roadside building with a sign reading HECETA FRAME & MATTING on a coastal highway, a HELP WANTED card in the window, an old Datsun pulling in, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: Inside. Frames on every wall. The OWNER, a woman in reading glasses, at a mat cutter. Wood in the door, already talking.

balloons.text: I should say up front that I consider the frame a form of criticism. What you exclude is—

image.prompt: the interior of a small picture-framing shop with frames covering the walls, a woman in reading glasses at a mat cutter, a young man in a chore coat talking in the doorway

panels.composition: Wood at the mat cutter. The blade. The corner. Clean.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man's hands guiding a mat cutter through a clean forty-five-degree corner on mat board

panels.composition: The owner, looking at the corner. Then at him.

characters.pose: holding the mat corner up to the light

balloons.text: Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays. Eight-fifty. Don't talk to the customers about criticism.

image.prompt: a woman in reading glasses holding a cut mat corner up to the light and speaking flatly to a young man

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Eight-fifty an hour. Three days. The scholarship letter is still pinned on the corkboard at home.
